motion: I THEREFORE MOVE that the City Council instruct the Los Angeles Bureau of Sanitation (LASAN) to report on the final results of water quality testing conducted on stormwater runoff associated with the June 17, 2026, Boyle Heights Lineage warehouse fire, including any findings regarding contaminants detected, impacts to receiving waters, and any recommendations for ongoing monitoring. I FURTHER MOVE that the City Council instruct LASAN to report on the status of the requested Cleanup and Abatement Order issued by the Los Angeles Regional Water Quality Control Board, including any approved remediation plan, implementation timeline, responsible agencies, and progress made toward protecting public health and water quality. PRESENTED BY (AC YSABEL JURADO — Councilmember, 14th District Au8342026 SECONDED BY
